messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Bulgarian, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Bulgarian line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.
Той ще я преследва през всеки град, докато я не върне обратно в ада, там откъдето завистта я изпрати първа.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Mapping Table**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition | Target Word/Phrase | Back‑Translation | Status | |-------------|----------------------|--------------------|-------------------|--------| | Questi | male agent (subject) | Той | he | OK | | la | accusative clitic, patient | я | her | OK | | caccerà | future “hunt” | преследва | hunt | OK | | per | preposition “through” | през | through | OK | | ogne | determiner “every” | всеки | every | OK | | villa | noun “town” | град | town | OK | | fin | subordinator “until” (part of *fin che*) | докато | until | OK | | che | complementizer in *fin che* | — (included in “докато”) | — | UNNECESSARY | | l’avrà | auxiliary “will have” (future) | ще | will | OK | | rimessa | past participle “set back” | върне | return | OK | | ne | preposition “in” | в | in | OK | | lo | definite article “the” (masc.) | — (Bulgarian has no article) | — | UNNECESSARY | | ’nferno | noun “hell” | ада | hell | OK | | là | adverb of place “there” | там | there | OK | | onde | relative adverb “whence” | откъдето | whence | OK | | ’nvidia | noun “envy” (personified) | завистта | envy | OK | | prima | adverb “first” (temporal) | първа | first | OK | | dipartilla | future “send forth” (with clitic *‑la*) | изпрати | send | OK |
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: *che*, *lo* – Bulgarian does not need a separate complementizer or definite article in these contexts. - No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** issues were detected.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Bulgarian script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Bulgarian text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- **Line 109** - **Original:** Той ще я преследва през всеки град, - **Issue:** none - **Corrected:** Той ще я преследва през всеки град,
- **Line 110** - **Original:** докато я не върне обратно в ада, - **Issue:** none - **Corrected:** докато я не върне обратно в ада,
- **Line 111** - **Original:** там откъдето завистта я изпрати първа. - **Issue:** none - **Corrected:** там откъдето завистта я изпрати първа.
``` Той ще я преследва през всеки град, докато я не върне обратно в ада, там откъдето завистта я изпрати първа. ```
